item.title: Fulton County, Georgia, to sue Trump administration over seizure of 2020 election records
item.description: Fulton County Commissioner Marvin Arrington Jr. said the county is filing a motion challenging the legality of the search and seizure of sensitive election records.

item.title: Ed Martin out as leader of DOJ's 'weaponization' group, sources say
item.description: Trump loyalist Ed Martin is out of his role as DOJ’s “weaponization” czar that is investigating prosecutors who launched past probes into President Donald Trump and his allies, sources say.

item.title: Tulsi Gabbard defends her presence at FBI search of Georgia elections hub
item.description: Director of National Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard on Monday defended her presence at an FBI search of an election center in Fulton County last week.

item.title: Search underway for Savannah Guthrie’s mother
item.description: On Nightly News, we always try to help our viewers by telling your stories and shining a light when we hear about problems in your communities. Tonight we are asking for your help to find Savannah Guthrie’s mom Nancy who has been missing since this weekend. NBC Nightly News anchor Tom Llamas has more.

item.title: 5-year-old boy and his father return to Minnesota after being released from immigration custody
item.description: A 5-year-old boy who became a viral symbol of the Trump administration’s immigration crackdown is back home after he and his father were released from an immigration facility in Texas on Saturday

item.title: Two more arrested in Minnesota church protest, Pam Bondi says
item.description: The announcement by the attorney general follows the arrest and release of journalist Don Lemon after a federal magistrate rejected the criminal complaint.

item.title: Federal judge postpones Trump admin's termination of TPS for Haitians
item.description: A federal judge on Monday indefinitely postponed the termination of protected immigration status for hundreds of thousands of Haitians in the United States.

item.title: Minneapolis field officers set to receive body cameras
item.description: Late today the Department of Homeland Security announced that every officer in Minneapolis will receive body cameras and that the program will expand nationwide. NBC News’ Maggie Vespa has more.

item.title: Clintons agree to testify in Epstein investigation
item.description: A spokesperson for Bill and Hillary Clinton says they have agreed to testify as part of the House Oversight Committee’s Epstein investigation. The House was moving closer to voting to hold the Clintons in contempt of Congress. It comes amid continued fallout from the release of millions of new Epstein documents. NBC News’ Hallie Jackson reports.
